backlog.title: File hashing on exec and file events
backlog.what: Record SHA-256/MD5 of executed images and written files in events.
backlog.why: Hash pivots enable IOC matching and prevalence without relying on paths.
backlog.data_needed: Agent-side hashing of image and file content
backlog.telemetry_sufficient: Insufficient: exec has path only, file has path/op/size only
backlog.risk: Hash cost on busy hosts; privacy of file reads

backlog.title: Process GUID / start-time keyed lineage
backlog.what: Stable process identity across all event types for reliable trees.
backlog.why: Pid reuse breaks storylines and joins.
backlog.data_needed: Process start time on every event; network has optional process_start
backlog.telemetry_sufficient: Partial: process_start exists but is optional

backlog.title: Process terminate events
backlog.what: Capture exits with exit time.
backlog.why: Gives lifetime of short-lived processes; supports burst detection.

backlog.title: Image/DLL/module load coverage across platforms
backlog.what: Native module load collection with signer and hash (ingest endpoint exists).
backlog.why: Detects sideloading and rogue drivers.
backlog.data_needed: Native collector emitting module events; hash and signature
backlog.telemetry_sufficient: Partial: /v1/events/module accepts events but no native collector evidenced

backlog.title: Process-to-process access and remote thread events
backlog.what: Cross-process memory access and injection telemetry.
backlog.why: Credential dumping and injection visibility.

backlog.title: Named pipe and WMI subscription events
backlog.what: Pipe create/connect and WMI filter/consumer events.
backlog.why: Lateral-movement and persistence tradecraft.

backlog.title: Network events with ports, protocol, direction, bytes
backlog.what: Enrich network events beyond destination string with ports, protocol, bytes, resolved name.
backlog.why: Needed for beaconing, exfil volume and service identification.

backlog.title: File writer attribution
backlog.what: Attach the writing process to file events.
backlog.why: File changes without an actor are hard to triage.
backlog.data_needed: fanotify/eBPF/ETW file hook; the current scanner cannot identify the writer

backlog.title: Alternate data stream / mark-of-the-web events
backlog.what: Detect downloaded-file provenance streams on Windows.
backlog.why: Phishing-delivery triage.

backlog.title: File-create-time tampering detection
backlog.what: Report timestomping.
backlog.why: Anti-forensics indicator.

backlog.title: Clipboard and process-tampering events
backlog.what: Hollowing/herpaderp and clipboard-change events.
backlog.why: Evasion visibility.

backlog.title: General query language over events
backlog.what: KQL/ES|QL/VQL-style expression language with joins and time windows for hunts.
backlog.competitors: Defender XDR KQL (S5), Elastic ES|QL (S6, S7), Velociraptor VQL (S12, S13), osquery SQL (S16)
backlog.why: Analysts can pivot without new code releases.
backlog.data_needed: Existing event store; parser and limits

backlog.title: Fleet-wide read-only live query
backlog.what: On-demand collection of OS state (processes, sockets, users) across hosts.
backlog.why: Answers 'is X present' quickly during incidents.
backlog.data_needed: Agent read-only collector set; allow-list of tables
backlog.telemetry_sufficient: Insufficient: no remote read channel beyond recorded RTR
backlog.conflicts_with_observation_only: Partially: remote collection resembles RTR; must be fixed read-only tables

backlog.title: Promote saved hunt to scheduled detection
backlog.what: Turn a saved hunt into an automatically running rule.
backlog.why: Closes the hunt-to-detection loop.

backlog.title: Hunt retention and quota controls
backlog.what: Documented retention window, row and time quotas on hunts.
backlog.why: Predictable analyst experience and DoS protection.

backlog.title: Offline evidence collector package
backlog.what: Portable read-only triage collector producing an archive for later ingest.
backlog.why: Covers hosts without a live agent.

backlog.title: Sigma coverage and rule-pack versioning
backlog.what: Report which Sigma rules map to available telemetry and track upstream versions.
backlog.why: Defenders trust content they can audit.

backlog.title: ATT&CK coverage gaps caused by missing telemetry
backlog.what: Show technique gaps due to absent telemetry, not only absent rules.
backlog.why: Directs collector investment.

backlog.title: Rule exceptions with expiry and alert suppression
backlog.what: Time-boxed exceptions and snooze with audit.
backlog.why: Reduces fatigue without losing history.
backlog.risk: Hidden blind spots if expiry ignored

backlog.title: Alert grouping into attack chains
backlog.what: Cluster related alerts into one attack narrative.
backlog.competitors: Elastic Attack Discovery (S6, S8), Defender incidents (S4), SentinelOne Storyline (S3, secondary)
backlog.why: Fewer, richer cases.

backlog.title: Native cloud audit-log collectors
backlog.what: Pull AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub and M365 audit logs.
backlog.why: Cloud attacks leave no host telemetry.

backlog.title: Agentless syslog device monitoring
backlog.what: Receive syslog from network gear and appliances.
backlog.why: Covers devices that cannot run agents.

backlog.title: Security configuration assessment policies
backlog.what: Benchmark checks with pass/fail evidence.
backlog.why: Hardening drift is a common root cause.

backlog.title: Offline vulnerability repository matching
backlog.what: Match installed packages to a local copy of a vulnerability repository.
backlog.why: Air-gapped customers get exposure data.
backlog.data_needed: Package inventory from agents; local feed copy

backlog.title: Exploit-likelihood prioritisation (EPSS, KEV)
backlog.what: Rank vulnerabilities by exploit signals.
backlog.why: Better prioritisation than CVSS alone.

backlog.title: Directory and identity provider log ingestion
backlog.what: Ingest AD and Entra sign-in and directory logs.
backlog.why: Identity is a main attack path.
backlog.telemetry_sufficient: Partial: identity events accepted, no native collector

backlog.title: Measured agent footprint and coverage SLOs
backlog.what: Publish measured CPU/memory per agent and coverage.
backlog.why: Defenders need evidence of low impact.

backlog.title: Continuous raw event streaming to customer lake
backlog.what: Extend SIEM export to a continuous raw event stream.
backlog.why: Longer retention in the customer's own lake.

backlog.title: Case templates, SLA timers and assignment
backlog.what: Case workflow beyond notes and tickets.
backlog.why: SOC process consistency.

backlog.title: Scheduled report exports
backlog.what: PDF/CSV scheduled reports to stakeholders.
backlog.why: Evidence for auditors.

backlog.title: Automatic attack disruption / host isolation
backlog.what: Auto-containment of hosts, accounts or mail.
backlog.competitors: Defender (S4), CrowdStrike (S1), Elastic (S8), Wazuh AR (S10), Velociraptor (S12)
backlog.why: Speeds containment.
backlog.conflicts_with_observation_only: YES: contradicts the product boundary; listed only to document the deliberate gap
